propositions: Failed identity writes (add_label, set_entity_property) after successful issue creation trigger an unconditional delete_issue rollback, destroying the created Jira issue to recover from a labeling failure

The write-ahead record_pending_key binds the local_id to jira_key before identity writes; rollback deletion leaves a keyed-pending binding pointing to a deleted key, stranding the ticket permanently as recover_pending repeatedly fails on the dead key

The Jira error 'Field x cannot be set. It is not on the appropriate screen' is misleading: it occurs when the field genuinely is not on the Create/Edit screen, when jira.permission.createclone.denied is set, or when the field value is malformed

Removing the delete_issue call is safe because recover_pending's KEYED branch already retro-attaches the label and entity property deterministically without search, precisely for this create-to-label window

The labels field must be declared as a screen requirement in documentation rather than solved via createmeta pre-flight discovery, following Sentry's precedent of not supporting custom required fields
